info.title: ussfc 1.4.1.2 - Universal Silent Setup Finder / Console
info.description: Universal Silent Setup Finder Console — identifies Windows installer types (NSIS, Inno, InstallShield, Wise, MSI, 7-Zip/CAB/ZIP/RAR SFX, UPX, etc.) and the silent-install command line for each. Ported from the original AutoIt USSF by Alexandru Avadanii.

options.name: --json
options.description: Output result as JSON instead of human-readable text.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help message.
--version, -v Show version information.
Supported file types:
.inf   Information / Installation file
.reg   Registry file
.msi   Windows Installer package
.exe   Executables (NSIS, Inno Setup, InstallShield, Wise, 7-Zip, WinZip, UPX, etc.)

arguments.name: FILE_PATH
arguments.description: Path to the installer or file to analyze.
